Messages.Author: ReverendRevolver
Messages.Body:
> Pagan wrote:
> Those were in the deck, I think that was Kevin questioning the inclusion of those cards in the deck.
>
> Wider View just gets in the way in this deck, since you almost always have transfers to use to gain 2 pool from minions.

How did Zurich work for you? Ive always worried about having spare actions, since normally with Samedi and dead hookers i have more to do in my hand than untapped minions (8-10 freak drives though, not 27). I dont worry alot about its steal mechanism, since the only deck that can routinely generate the edge before untapping is Cock Ronin cog (or my old Anatole deck, but normally i can burn the edge for pool to Victoria and not waste an action and 4 transfers for it).

Messages.Author: Pagan
Messages.Body:
I think I drew it in rounds 1 and 2 and just refused to put it into play and discarded it since I couldn't guarantee I wouldn't lose control of it and the deck already had enough actions to keep it busy.

*It getting stolen was a real threat since I don't think I had more than a handful of games all week that did not have an Enkil Cog hit the table somewhere.
